title: habitat research person
description: The YAML front matter of an optional research/people/<id>.md file. A kind of person the product serves, described by their situation rather than invented biography, and grounded in insights. Optional: teams without evidence-based descriptions of their users can leave research/people/ empty.

id.description: A short id that insights refer to, e.g. 'sole-trader'.

name.description: A plain label for the group, e.g. 'Sole trader'. Not a made-up name and photo.

situation.description: Their context when they use the product: where, when, with what else going on.

goals.description: What they are trying to get done.

constraints.description: What limits them: time, device, connection, knowledge, language, money.

stateOfMind.description: How they tend to feel while using it, e.g. tired, anxious about money, in a hurry.

accessibility.description: Access needs that are common in this group.

evidence.description: The insight ids this description rests on.
